name: 05055 · Norwich, VT
findings: ZIP 05055 (Norwich) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 05055 (Norwich) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 05055 (Norwich) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
